## Improvement: staged feature and story triage

Condition:
- When moving a feature from In Design to Waiting for Implementation and then triaging its direct DEV-STORY children

Action:
- Do inspect each direct child and link set through the CLI, verify DoD evidence before writing, preflight each status transition, and record role-authored evidence before updating status.

## Improvement: unblock approved code reviews safely

Condition:
- When CODEREVIEW child Blocked and linked DEV Resolved

Action:
- Do inspect every link and blocker status through CLI; remove only configured DEV-to-CODEREVIEW Blocks link; verify Blocked-to-Open transition; post file/line evidence before Closed; leave parent stories to automation.

## Improvement: verify tracker working directory first

Condition:
- When starting a tracker CLI operation from a Windows workspace with a nested project directory

Action:
- Do confirm the command runs from repository root where `.ept/skills/tracking-system/tracker/tracker_cli.py` exists before the first tracker call; if invocation fails, correct path once and stop dependent work on any remaining failure.

## Improvement: honor stop before mutation

Condition:
- When caller says stop before or during a tracker update

Action:
- Do stop all pending tracker writes immediately; report that no mutation ran, with exact completed read-only results and exit codes; do not start additional tracker queries after the stop.

## Improvement: Treat assignee evidence as insufficient manager verification

Condition:
- When a transition DoD requires manager verification and evidence comments contain only assignee-authored claims

Action:
- Do leave status unchanged until a manager verification record is present; report missing verification as an unmet criterion.

## Improvement: honor narrowly scoped status updates

Condition:
- When caller names exact tickets, supplies current statuses/evidence, specifies mutation order, and forbids broad audit

Action:
- Do validate only named tickets, preserve requested mutation order, post caller-supplied evidence before the requested transition check, run that check immediately before the status update, and don't retrieve unrelated ticket data or touch other tickets.

## Improvement: evidence-only ticket handling

Condition:
- When caller requests follow-up evidence comments for exact tickets and says to keep status unchanged if DoD is unmet

Action:
- Do retrieve only named tickets, post role-authored evidence comments with exact pass counts, durable paths, and explicit unverified full-suite or remote/distribution items, leave statuses unchanged when any DoD criterion is missing, run requested transition checks, and don't touch unrelated tickets.

## Improvement: block QA when distribution verification is unavailable

Condition:
- When TESTCASE or TESTEXEC evidence passes locally but fresh-clone, release-tag, or remote-distribution verification fails

Action:
- Do record each failing distribution command and exit code, cite the release workflow and distribution README, and keep QA work Blocked until remote access and expected skill-folder count are verified. Do not treat local test, lint, type, compile, or launcher passes as distribution proof.

## Improvement: readiness preflight by ticket type and link

Condition:
- When read-only preparation asks for exact advancement evidence for several tickets sharing type and status

Action:
- Do get every named ticket, query one transition map and one full type definition per shared type/status, and list links for every ticket. State both the target DoD and each live blocker; explicitly report any Blocked ticket whose blocker ID or blocking link is absent; do not mutate readiness state.

## Improvement: distinguish field-only time updates from status transitions

Condition:
- When a sub-task DoD requires `time_spent_hours` and the caller asks how to record it without changing status

Action:
- Do verify `time_spent_hours` appears in the ticket type optional fields, then give `update <ticket-id> --field time_spent_hours=<hours> --author <role>` separately from the later `--status Resolved` command. Do not combine or execute either command during read-only preparation.
## Improvement: honor stop before dependent review writes

Condition:
- When caller explicitly stops a multi-step ticket task before comment or status mutation

Action:
- Do report exact mutation and status state; do not run remaining tracker writes or reads.

## Improvement: clear stale QA blockers without false closure

Condition:
- When blocked QA tickets have no live blocking links and new evidence clears the former local blocker but does not satisfy closure DoD

Action:
- Do record PASS scope and residual non-claims, move only Blocked -> Open after transition validation, preserve containment links, and leave tickets open; create QUESTION blockers only for genuinely unresolved blockers.

## Improvement: close QA batches only on explicit DoD evidence

Condition:
- When launcher and focused-test evidence is positive but review approval, dependent test-case closure, or per-case execution records are absent

Action:
- Do record the evidence and time field, advance only to the highest validated status, and create a narrowly scoped QUESTION/Blocks link for unresolved acceptance decisions. Never infer closure from aggregate test counts or local-only evidence.

## Improvement: stop link lookup when exact search returns no ticket

Condition:
- When a read-only request names exact ticket IDs and documented CLI searches return zero matches

Action:
- Do run one documented search per exact ID, report each raw result and exit code, then stop unless caller explicitly requests direct retrieval; for that request, run only documented typed exact get/list/comment/link operations for supplied IDs, report search-vs-retrieval ambiguity, never broaden query or create replacements.

## Improvement: separate numeric search from explicit ID retrieval

Condition:
- When read-only request asks numeric searches plus exact ticket gets, and type-filter list confirms named IDs

Action:
- Do run documented numeric searches, type-filter list, then requested exact gets; report raw output and exit code for each; don't broaden search or mutate tickets.

## Improvement: formalize undocumented blocked tickets

Condition:
- When a ticket is already Blocked but has only containment links or a status-only comment

Action:
- Do preserve the prior Blocked status, create one role-directed QUESTION under the same story, link QUESTION -> target with Blocks and target -> QUESTION with Question, and record the blocker plus prior status on the target. Do not invent a substantive blocker when the existing record is silent; ask the owner to identify the missing prerequisite.

## Improvement: Redirect comment-create output when a long body makes terminal echo unwieldy (strengthened 20260814)

Condition:
- When executing a tracker CLI comment create whose --text body is long multiline Markdown and the PowerShell terminal echo of the full command risks truncating the confirmation line, OR when an inline long-body comment create completes with exit 0 but the tool result truncates the command echo and hides the Created comment confirmation

Action:
- Do either (a) append 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath <log>.log -Encoding utf8; Write-Output "OP_EXIT:$LASTEXITCODE" so the created-comment confirmation is captured to a file, or (b) when the inline result is truncated, recover the comment ID via one read-only comment list <ticket-id> and verify body preservation via one read-only comment get <ticket-id> <comment-id>; never re-run comment create (would duplicate the comment). CLI exit code remains authoritative via $LASTEXITCODE. Confirmed on TESTCASE-020 (20260810), UNITTEST-022 (20260811), and TESTCASE-037 (20260814): inline comment create exit 0, comment ID 20260814-173133-qa-engineer recovered via comment list, body byte-for-byte verified via comment get.

## Improvement: stage comment bodies containing single quotes via single-quoted here-string + newline-to-\n replace

Condition:
- When comment create --text body contains single quotes (e.g. git pathspec ':(exclude)...') making plain single-quoted $BODY unsafe, or when multi-line terminal output capture truncates verification output

Action:
- Do stage the body via single-quoted here-string @'...'@ then convert real newlines to literal \n with -replace "`r?`n", '\n' so CLI --text decodes them; verify integrity with minimal one-line checks (body length, single quotes preserved, literal \r text preserved) before executing the CLI command.
